_readme: Support contacts shown on the support/crisis screen. Every entry needs verified_at (YYYY-MM-DD): the date a teammate opened the official page and confirmed the number/link still works. npm run db:seed-safety refuses to load entries without it. Exactly one entry may have is_primary_crisis: true (shown first). type: crisis | counselling | self_help. tags: theme codes (sleep, workload, exams, isolation, relationships, finance, health, motivation).
